body:
## Parent

https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/issues/1

## What to build

Run all interactions together, resolve shared UI/state conflicts, and recommend retaining Readium, retaining it with explicit limitations, or reopening the engine choice.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Rerun every spec acceptance check in the combined Android prototype; map each to fixture, steps, versions, outcome, and evidence. Distinguish passed, failed, and not exercised.
- [ ] Compare warm resume and force-stop/relaunch while reading, selecting, viewing notes, and previewing slider destinations. Exercise selection-handle and slider-pointer interruption where automation permits.
- [ ] Check lookup on highlighted text, selection around note links, and note/lookup interactions during preview where supported. Fix narrow accidental-navigation, menu-ownership, and persistence conflicts. File larger conflicts as follow-up tickets and mark affected checks failed.
- [ ] Define and verify one Android Back dismissal policy across selection, lookup, notes, and slider preview, including combinations the UI permits.
- [ ] Verify actual bookmark/annotation-list jumps do not add slider history, alongside chapter and diagnostic search-result jumps.
- [ ] Present slider commitment/return, note/backlink dismissal, lookup presentation, and other provisional choices to the project owner with evidence. Record each decision as accepted, changed, or deferred. This ticket stays open until the owner responds; pending review is never reported as approval.
- [ ] Deliver a runnable prototype, reproducible fixtures, run/test instructions, combined results report, and engine recommendation. Separate app-owned dictionary/extraction gaps from engine blockers.
- [ ] Report gate status as passed or failed separately from the engine recommendation. Any failed or not-exercised spec check keeps the gate failed, whether app-owned or engine-owned. A recommendation to retain with explicit limitations lists those checks. Failed investigations include reproducible failures and proposed next steps; ticket completion does not pass the gate.

## Blocked by

- https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/issues/3
- https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/issues/4
- https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/issues/6
- https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/issues/7

## Scope and evidence

Use the parent spec as the scope reference. Verify on the running Android reader and record reproducible fixtures, actions, versions, and outcomes. Ticket completion does not imply the Readium adoption gate passed.

Agent implementation and evidence preparation come first. The ticket remains open while awaiting the project owner review required by its acceptance criteria.

comments.body:
Combined validation started from integrated branch `prototype/android-reader` at `2e26d4c`. Full approved #8 and parent #1 bodies, comments, status and native dependencies were reread; #3/#4/#6/#7 are closed and integrated.

One isolated agent owns the emulator for the complete combined Android matrix. A separate isolated audit checks reproducible build/fixtures, public dictionary input/output and evidence coverage without device access. Shared menu and position changes are coordinated by the orchestrator. Existing schema-v2 app data is preserved.

The gate currently remains FAILED because failed and unexercised checks remain. The engine recommendation will be reported separately, with app-owned gaps distinguished from Readium limitations. This issue stays open until the owner reviews the concrete provisional interactions. Parent #1 is unchanged.

Independent fixture/build/public dictionary audit is integrated and published. The combined Android run is still in progress; this is not a final result. [Gate checkpoint and audit](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/blob/prototype/android-reader/docs/evidence/issue-8/README.md).

Current runtime reruns include both languages, source-independent English import/restart, natural chapter boundary, native accented/conjugated/plural/contraction selections, four offline dictionary imports, malformed rejection, highlight/note editing and highlighted-text lookup, real annotation/bookmark list navigation, typography/restart and multiline selection. Remaining notes/slider/interruption subchecks are explicitly pending.

Two required gaps were reproduced on the combined reader and recorded as triage follow-ups: [#9](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/issues/9) for GCIDE English base forms without aliases, and [#10](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/issues/10) for native selection across the controlled page boundary. These checks stay FAILED. No change to parent #1, no owner approval, and no gate pass is implied. #8 remains open.

Agent implementation, integration and combined Android evidence preparation are complete on `prototype/android-reader`. #2–#7 are closed and integrated. No #8 source fixes were needed. Parent #1 remains unchanged.

[Combined results and engine recommendation](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/blob/prototype/android-reader/docs/evidence/issue-8/README.md), [13-group Android report](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/blob/prototype/android-reader/docs/evidence/issue-8/runtime-report.md), [independent fixture/build/public-IO audit](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/blob/prototype/android-reader/docs/evidence/issue-8/audit-report.md), [reproducible build/run/test instructions](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/blob/prototype/android-reader/android/README.md).

Gate status: **FAILED**. English monolingual GCIDE plural compatibility is failed, follow-up #9. Controlled native page-boundary selection is failed, follow-up #10; lookup-panel/menu versus native/engine attribution remains unresolved. Declared but unexercised variants and lifecycle cases are explicit. Completed investigations and passing host tests do not pass the gate.

Recommendation: **retain Readium with explicit limitations for the prototype**, with production adoption still gated. Reading, same-page annotations, controlled note overlays, local resume and slider state are demonstrated; pinned internal JavaScript locator corrections and block-level precision are material limits. Reopen the engine choice if required selection/restoration cannot be achieved after isolating app behavior.

Final runtime evidence `270a08c` includes fresh archived DOWN/MOVE, force-stop-before-UP and restored-source checks, actual bookmark/list versus Return comparisons, offline definitions/both directions, nested backlink and preview/lookup/note Back combinations. Earlier failed automation and incomplete timing artifacts are retained honestly. Independent review found no material overclaim in sampled evidence. Tested APK SHA256 `7b20f861c7bea04619db1d61aee52a46e59f6c4d6e39c4e54fc62bacdc6148b0`, app0.1.0, schema2, Android16/API36/WebView133.0.6943.137. Device lease/session released; app remains runnable offline at the generic source heading.

**Owner review request:** reply to each of the five rows in [the concrete review](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/blob/prototype/android-reader/docs/evidence/issue-8/owner-review.md) with **accepted**, **change** plus desired behavior, or **deferred**. Rows cover slider commitment/Return, interruption/progress display, note/backlink dismissal, lookup/passage presentation and Back/warm behavior. All decisions are currently PENDING. Accepting a hypothesis does not waive failed compatibility checks. This issue stays OPEN until the owner responds.

Owner-requested UI pass #11 is implemented, independently reviewed and Android-verified at `fe9a2da` on `prototype/android-reader`. Top options, slider-only bottom and actual Material 3 Expressive replace the original combined baseline's chrome. Lookup now uses a compact source dropdown with the answer first. [Current UI evidence and build details](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/blob/fe9a2da/docs/evidence/issue-11/README.md).

Source algorithms and persistence remain unchanged. New runtime evidence covers preview/cancel/Return, reflow/restart and lookup routes without claiming a full rerun of all baseline permutations. #9/#10 remain unresolved; gate remains FAILED. #8 stays open for the owner's provisional interaction review. Appearance review is also pending in #11. Parent #1 unchanged; no PR created. Compatibility implementation is paused while the UI is reviewed.

title: Prototype 07: Validate the combined reader and decide on Readium
